functions.name: build_test_pack
functions.description: Run the review-before-code test-pack workflow: extract and classify requirements, produce human-readable test cases and a traceability matrix, and stop at a review gate.

sources.description: Ordered source references (PRD, acceptance criteria, Figma, repo, staging).

scope.description: Optional scope note or target flow.

functions.name: extract_requirements
functions.description: Extract grounded requirements from PRD/acceptance-criteria text and classify each by approved type.

functions.name: generate_playwright_specs
functions.description: Generate @playwright/test specs from an approved test pack. Only call after the review gate is approved.

base_url_env.description: Env var name holding the base URL.

functions.name: generate_test_report
functions.description: Generate a test report from execution results.
